name: @zaxbyhub/zmem-deepseek
description: ZMem native DeepSeek Harness (dsh/Cordis) adapter: broker-backed passive recall on the first accepted pre-step, explicit zmem_* memory tools through the same backend, capture with always-on redaction, and offline snapshot delivery (issues #374/#375).

runtime.loader: cordis.yml profile row (the dsh product loader; not part of the published packages)

events.agent/pre-step: user_prompt moment (first accepted pre-step delivery; reservation acknowledged only after observed admission)
events.tools/pre-execute: pretool context collection (next-request guidance; declared capability gap for the in-flight tool)
events.tools/result: final tool-outcome capture (failures and denials only)
events.agent/turn-stopping: bounded reflection: the shared reflect hook runs inside the bound (its own eligibility/idempotency govern) and the plugin surfaces the nudge as state for the host — never a self-triggered continuation
events.session/event: admission observation (ack) and compaction marker serialization (string-matched)
events.agent/disposed: persisted-session state is never terminal-cleared; acks are synchronous and bounded at the admission moment (12s) — no async tails to drain
